limitations: Pure scalar kernel only; named roles do not prove vault business units, share ownership or complete deposit semantics.
Selected typed i64 quantities, IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest/ties-to-even, gradual underflow, valid collection layouts, and normal helper returns are premises.
Positive-delta prelude, overflow-report side effects, collection search/insert/sort/allocation/cleanup and unwinding are not reconstructed by the Rust scalar function.
Writeback means original in-memory map payload, not disk durability. No full map API, admission, authorization, storage persistence or acceptance-gate change.
No captured target execution/emulation. Synthetic exact-rational comparisons are not a native runtime differential oracle.
